_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Frederick Whishaw (1854-1934): Dostoevsky for Vizetelly's One-Volume Novels (London, 1886-88), the first English run of Dostoevsky's novels. US public domain (pre-1931); UK: Whishaw d. 1934, PD there since 2005. Garnett's later versions of the same novels are on garnett_shelf.json (another translator, another witness). Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 16); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_surname_note: Never the bare 'whishaw' alone; J. Whishaw edited Mungo Park.
